correctness.rationale: For crisp directed R-path height<=H (paths allow repeat so no cycles), modal-height truncation T_b replaces modal subformulas by truth constants at bound zero and decreases budget under modalities. Induction on formula and remaining height gives e(w,phi)=e(w,T_b phi) at worlds of height<=b. Hence at every successor of world height h the unrestricted operand agrees with depth<=h-1 transform; H-witnessing attains its extrema, giving full witnessing. Explicit height-exactly H countable model has infinitely branching root to chains of H-1 edges; leaf p=1/n, all other p=1. Every depth<=H-2 operand is constant across root successors, while root inf of Box^(H-1)p equals0 never attained: (H-1)-witnessed but not H-witnessed. Finitely branching and globally finite atomic ranges ensure all infima/suprema attained. Covers H=0 and H=1 boundary cases, with infinite nonattainment proved analytically rather than via finite truncation.
